column1: # LawCraft's own interface strings for sl, added to WordCraft's catalog by build.rs.
# Same format as craft-i18n's catalogs: context <TAB> English <TAB> translation.

column2: Each add-in stays off until you turn it on.
column3: Vsak dodatek ostane izklopljen, dokler ga ne vklopite.

column2: The PDF is now an editable copy. Save it as a new document; the original PDF has not changed.
column3: PDF je zdaj kopija, ki jo lahko urejate. Shranite jo kot nov dokument; izvirni PDF ni spremenjen.

column2: PDF imported as an editable copy.
column3: PDF je uvožen kot kopija, ki jo lahko urejate.

column2: PDF layout is reconstructed approximately. Tables, columns, forms, links, annotations and document structure are not reconstructed.
column3: Postavitev PDF je obnovljena približno. Tabele, stolpci, obrazci, povezave, pripombe in zgradba dokumenta niso obnovljeni.

column2: Some pages have no extractable text. Their pictures remain images; OCR is not performed.
column3: Nekatere strani nimajo besedila, ki bi ga bilo mogoče izvleči. Njihove slike ostanejo slike; optično prepoznavanje znakov (OCR) se ne izvede.

column2: Vector drawings, rules and decorative backgrounds are not imported.
column3: Vektorske risbe, črte in okrasna ozadja niso uvožene.

column2: Some characters have no usable Unicode mapping and were replaced with �.
column3: Nekateri znaki nimajo uporabne preslikave Unicode in so bili zamenjani z �.

column2: Rotated, right-to-left or unusually positioned content needs review after conversion to horizontal text and inline pictures.
column3: Po pretvorbi v vodoravno besedilo in slike v vrstici preglejte zasukano vsebino, vsebino od desne proti levi in nenavadno postavljeno vsebino.

column2: The PDF interpreter reported unsupported or unreadable content; inspect the converted document.
column3: Tolmač PDF je javil nepodprto ali neberljivo vsebino; preglejte pretvorjeni dokument.

column2: To protect the converted document, set a password when saving it. The PDF password only unlocks the source.
column3: Če želite zaščititi pretvorjeni dokument, ob shranjevanju nastavite geslo. Geslo PDF odklene le izvirnik.
